lines.say: E.A. made this skate game, but Konami brought it to the NES. Here's the backstory.
lines.cap: EA made this skate game, but Konami brought it to the NES. Here's the backstory.

lines.say: Skate or Die launched in 1987 on the Commodore sixty-four, as E.A.'s first game made in-house.
lines.cap: Skate or Die launched in 1987 on the Commodore 64, as EA's first game made in-house.

lines.say: In 1988, Konami ported it to the NES, under a side label called Ultra Games,
a trick to get around Nintendo's yearly limit on releases.
Five events: freestyle ramp, high jump, two downhill races, and the pool joust.
In the joust, you battle punks like Poser Pete, Aggro Eddie, and the boss, Lester.
lines.cap: In the joust, you battle punks like Poseur Pete, Aggro Eddie, and the boss, Lester.
